intro.title: Engineering metrics
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple dashboard to track and display key engineering metrics, such as deployment frequency and lead time for changes. You will learn how to define, calculate, and visualize these metrics using basic data structures and functions. The main constructs involved include variables, arrays, objects, and simple loops for data processing. This hands-on exercise will help you understand the importance of metrics in measuring team performance and guiding engineering decisions.
intro.usecase: Engineering metrics are essential for data-driven leadership in tech companies, appearing in product dashboards that track team performance, sprint velocity, and code quality. These metrics power executive reports at companies like Google and Amazon, where engineering leaders monitor deployment frequency, lead time for changes, and mean time to recovery. Practical examples include GitHub's Insights dashboard, Jira's velocity charts, and internal tools that visualize pull request throughput and incident response times. Developers implement these metrics to make informed decisions about resource allocation, process improvements, and team health assessments.
